embeds.title: OFFICIAL BLHA ANNOUNCEMENTS
embeds.description: This channel is the official notice board of the Beer League Hockey Association. Managers are responsible for monitoring it.

fields.name: POSTED HERE
fields.value: Deadlines • Season notices • Calendar changes • Commissioner instructions • League-wide action items

fields.name: NOT POSTED HERE
fields.value: General discussion, trade talk, scouting chatter or routine questions.

fields.name: RULES CHANGES
fields.value: Rules change only through the process in Article XX of the Constitution. An announcement never changes a rule by itself.
